messages:
Jamie: Quick sync — want to run a small live experiment on the pricing page this week. goal: reduce FAQ-driven support tickets and increase calculator starts by 8%
Ava: +1. what’s the variant plan? microcopy + CTA + lead routing?
Jamie: Yep. Thinking 3 arms: (A) current copy, (B) streamlined tier names + shorter FAQ blurbs, (C) B + stronger calc CTA (’Estimate your bill in 30s’). also add a hidden utm for inbound routing.
Ravi: For the calc CTA language I’d prefer tests that call out time savings and cost clarity. samples: ’See estimated monthly cost’, ’Estimate your bill in 30s’, ’Compare tiers by usage’.
Denise: From CS perspective, we should add a one-line FAQ at top: ‘How do committed vs metered pricing affect my bill?’ that links to a short explainer. That should cut repeated tickets.
Jamie: Good call. keep FAQ answers < 2 sentences, link to the explainer doc. we’ll A/B the single-line vs no-single-line.
Ava: Growth asks: add routing tags so leads who use the calc and click contact are flagged as ‘calc_interested’ in Intercom. can we do that without changing backend?
Ravi: Yes — we can append a URL param and our flow will pick it up. growth-bot can record events. snippet for front-end: `window.location.search += '&redwood_lead_tag=calc_interested'`
Denise: Also recommend pinning an FAQ anchor near the top so people on mobile see it before scrolling.
Jamie: Timeline: build variants today, QA tomorrow, launch Friday for 1 week. tracking: GA funnel + segment in Intercom + support ticket volume.
Ava: Can we add a small webinar CTA for tier walkthroughs? maybe low-key: ‘Join a 30min pricing Q&A — weekly’. put it under calculator for variant C only.
Ravi: OK add second CTA with `data-experiment=pricing_webinar` so we can track impressions and clicks.
growth-bot: [event created] Experiment 'pricing-tier-microcopy-1894506789' created. Goals: calc_starts, faq_clicks, inbound_leads_tagged.
Denise: Owners: Jamie (experiment lead), Ava (growth tagging + funnel), Ravi (frontend implementation), me (CS copy + support routing). I’ll prep the FAQ 1-liner and explainer doc.
Jamie: Perfect. small checklist: 1) variants pushed to staging (Ravi) 2) GA events wired (Ava) 3) Intercom routing rule (Ava + Denise) 4) Copy + webinar blurb (Denise) 5) Launch Friday 9am PT (Jamie).
Ava: I’ll schedule a 15m sync Thu morning to validate events.
Ravi: Will push PR by EOD and share staging link.
Denise: Drafting explainer now, will share for quick review in #marketing-docs.
Jamie: Thanks team — if metrics look good after 1 week we’ll roll variant C live and route qualified leads to AE queue. :thumbsup:
Ava: tiny note — let's include a short survey on calculator completion: one question modal asking ‘Was this estimate helpful?’ optional. should be low friction.
Ravi: Can do. simple modal with yes/no, sends event `calc_survey_response`.
Jamie: Alright closing thread. action items in the doc.
